release_notes: Admin account list (/admin/account) redesign: each owner group is now a centered, collapsible card with a 'OwnerName N accounts' header (click to expand/collapse), its own repeated column header row, and a ••• separator between groups. Header padding tightened so the reseller name sits close to the account table. Also fixed the 'Total Accounts' stat, which previously counted owner groups instead of accounts (showed 1 for 4 accounts).
